name: Approval without vote
title: RECOMMENDATION FOR SECOND READING on the Council position at first reading with a view to the adoption of a regulation of the European Parliament and of the Council establishing the Union Customs Code and the European Union Customs Authority, and repealing Regulation (EU) No 952/2013
part_text:
The European Parliament has approved the Council's position on a new set of customs rules for the European Union. The new regulation replaces the existing customs code and sets up a European Union Customs Authority. Parliament and the Council had already reached an agreement on the text before this vote, so this step confirms the deal rather than changing it. The report itself does not add new rules; it approves what was agreed.

- **What changes:** A new Union Customs Code replaces the current one, and a new European Union Customs Authority is created.
- **Who it affects:** Everyone involved in importing goods into or exporting goods from the European Union, and national customs authorities.
- **What happens next:** The act is signed and published in the Official Journal, then it applies.
